Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC (ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS) FOR BIDDING Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. Installation, Commissioning and Operational Training The bidder shall ensure proper installation, commissioning and successful demo nstration of the instrument at the purchaser's institution. The installation shall b e carried out by qualified and experienced technical personnel. The bidder shall provide comprehensive hands-on training to the designated faculty members a nd technical staff regarding instrument operation, software handling, calibration, routine maintenance, safety precautions and basic troubleshooting. All installation, commissioning and initial training activities shall be completed o n-site without any additional cost to the purchaser. 2. After-Sales Service and Technical Support The bidder shall ensure prompt, reliable and accessible after-sales service and t echnical support at the installation site throughout the warranty period. The bid der shall have adequate technical support arrangements within Kerala to attend to service requests without undue delay. A qualified service engineer shall be m ade available for on-site inspection and troubleshooting whenever required. The bidder shall provide contact details of the designated service personnel and ens ure continuous technical assistance for the smooth functioning of the instrumen t. 3. Timely Maintenance and Breakdown Support The bidder shall provide timely preventive maintenance, breakdown support an d necessary technical assistance throughout the warranty period. The bidder sh all respond to service complaints within 24–48 hours and arrange an on-site visi t, wherever necessary, within 3 working days of receiving the complaint. Any de fective parts or components requiring replacement during the warranty period s hall be repaired or replaced without additional cost, as per the warranty terms. The bidder shall ensure that service interruptions are minimised and that the in strument remains in proper working condition. 4. The bidder should have a registered office in Kerala. Upload the Kerala GST c ertificate. 5. Share the following details Details of the bidder's service centre or technical support facility in Kerala. Cont act details of the service engineer responsible for the institution. 6. The bidder shall be responsible to do the necessary electrical works for the pr oper installation of the equipment at the buyer’s institution. PRODUCT SPECIFICATION High-speed weighing with 2-second stabilization · Removable, shatterproof bree ze break with antistatic coating · Compact foot print: 198 mm × 294 mm (small er than an A4 sheet of paper) · 2-second stabilization with the C-SHS technology : The high-speed, efficient weighing increases productivity and user satisfaction. · Ditachable cylindrical breeze break: The breeze break is easily removed using a unique clip system, allowing fast, simple cleaning and use in confined spaces such as gloveboxes and controlled environment cabinets. It also makes the bala nce highly portable. · Rotary sliding doors requiring no extra space at the rear · Adjustable response characteristics to help cope with the effect of drafts and vi

brations · Multiple weighing units: g, mg, oz, ozt, ct, mom, dwt, grain, specific gr avity, and a user programmable unit for conversion applications (either tael, tol a or Newton can be added upon request) · Easily visible, front-mounted spirit level for adjusting the leveling feet · External calibration Clear, reverse-backlit L CD · GLP/GMP/GCP/ISO compliant output · Clock and calendar function · Countin g mode with the Automatic Counting Accuracy Improvement (ACAI) function · Pe rcent mode function · Animal weighing (hold) function · Statistical calculation fu nction · Comparator function with buzzer · Auto power on/off function · Underho ok function · Density determination function and an optional density determinati on kit · Built-in rechargeable battery (optional) · Weighing capacity : 252 g · Mini mum weighing value : 0.1 mg · Repeatability (Standard deviation) : 0 to 200 g: 0.1 mg, 200 to 252 g: 0.2 mg · Linearity: ±0.3 mg · Sensitivity drift (10 °C to 30 °C) : ±2 ppm/°C · Weighing pan : Ø90 mm . 3. If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6.
